fixed.summary: Rust emitters now use the same per-kind blend default as effect files: alpha for lit meshes and additive otherwise. Explicit blend choices are unchanged.

breaking.change: The field is now Option<ParticleBlend>; None retains the per-kind default.
breaking.fix: Wrap explicit Rust blend values in Some and read the resolved value with emitter.blend(). Effect files and the TypeScript API need no changes.
